name: Verified GitHub Repositories Catalog
content: Advaith's portfolio lists 39 projects; 34 are public repositories on GitHub (github.com/advaithsarva) and 5 are private or not yet published. Categories: AI Agents (9), NLP & RAG (8), Systems from Scratch (6), ML & Data (5), Full-Stack (6), In Progress (4), plus the IBM hackathon project. Featured public repositories include ibm-hackathon, media-nlp-pipeline, graph-rag-knowledge-system, autonomous-performance-agent and fact-checking-agent.
